reader_summary.headline: When innovation and capital go global, so do restrictions on trade, foreign investment, and more.
reader_summary.overview: When innovation and capital go global, so do restrictions on trade, foreign investment, and more. policymakers have expanded the scope of the Committee on Foreign Investment in the U.S. (CFIUS) through the Foreign Investment Risk Review Modernization Act (FIRRMA) of 2018 which was recently updated through proposed reforms this September 2019 .

key_points.text: So what does this all mean for tech founders taking investments from, or doing joint ventures with.
What does and doesn't CFIUS cover, and how might one structure partnerships strategically as a result?
